snippet.title: Lachesis or Atropos - Steam announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Lachesis or Atropos, a horror yuri visual novel, is coming to Steam!

Wishlist here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234770/Lachesis_or_Atropos/

Presskit:
https://www.quill-studios.com/presskit/lachesis-or-atropos/

Content warnings:
Please be advised that this visual novel contains violence, death, cults, monstrous creatures, and alcohol abuse.
